name: Flash
description: Teleport a short distance toward your cursor.

name: Ignite
description: Sets an enemy champion on fire, dealing true damage over time and applying Grievous Wounds.

name: Ghost
description: Gain a large burst of movement speed that decays over time; takedowns extend its duration.

name: Heal
description: Restores health to you and a nearby ally and grants a short burst of movement speed.

name: Barrier
description: Shields you from damage for a short time.

name: Exhaust
description: Exhausts an enemy champion, reducing their movement speed and damage dealt.

name: Smite
description: Deals true damage to a monster or minion; upgrades to Champion Smite after consuming charges.
